intro: Venomtail Antidote is a specialized concoction brewed to neutralize the lethal toxins of Durotar's venomtail scorpids. Prepared by Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar, it serves as an urgent remedy for Rhinag, an afflicted troll scout stranded near the northwestern border of Durotar.

p: The arid expanse of Durotar crawls with dangerous wildlife, none more hazardous to careless wanderers than the local scorpids. A deep sting from a venomtail delivers a virulent poison capable of killing an adult warrior within an hour. When the troll Rhinag found himself envenomed far from aid near the northwestern border, his only survival lay in obtaining a specialized remedy from Kor'ghan, an apothecary sequestered deep within Orgrimmar's subterranean Cleft of Shadow.

Securing the antidote requires navigating the underbelly of Orgrimmar to locate Kor'ghan. Knowledgeable in desert toxins and harsh remedies, Kor'ghan prepares the vial to purge the venom before it turns fatal. Once delivered, the draught halts the venom's progression, sparing Rhinag a humiliating death in the wilderness—though Kor'ghan demands further trials and hunts from the scout to atone for his carelessness.
